entries.title: 用模式切分字符串
entries.summary: Lua 没有 split，需要自己用 gmatch 或 find 实现。
entries.license: Original QFLI curriculum; reference link retained. CC BY 4.0
entries.code:
local function splitSimple(text, sep)
  local out = {}
  for piece in text:gmatch("([^" .. sep .. "]+)") do
    out[#out + 1] = piece
  end
  return out
end

local function splitKeepEmpty(text, sep)
  local out, position = {}, 1
  while true do
    local found = text:find(sep, position, true)
    if not found then
      out[#out + 1] = text:sub(position)
      return out
    end
    out[#out + 1] = text:sub(position, found - 1)
    position = found + #sep
  end
end

print(#splitSimple("a,,b", ","))
print(table.concat(splitKeepEmpty("a,,b", ","), "|"))
print(#splitKeepEmpty("a,,b", ","))

local Queue = {}
Queue.__index = Queue

function Queue.new()
  return setmetatable({ items = {}, head = 1, tail = 0 }, Queue)
end

function Queue:push(value)
  self.tail = self.tail + 1
  self.items[self.tail] = value
end

function Queue:pop()
  if self.head > self.tail then return nil end
  local value = self.items[self.head]
  self.items[self.head] = nil
  self.head = self.head + 1
  return value
end

function Queue:size()
  return self.tail - self.head + 1
end

local function set(list)
  local result = {}
  for _, value in ipairs(list) do result[value] = true end

local function union(a, b)
  local result = {}
  for key in pairs(a) do result[key] = true end
  for key in pairs(b) do result[key] = true end
  return result
end

local function intersection(a, b)
  local result = {}
  for key in pairs(a) do
    if b[key] then result[key] = true end
  end
  return result
end

local function difference(a, b)
  local result = {}
  for key in pairs(a) do
    if not b[key] then result[key] = true end
  end
  return result
end

  local list = {}
  for key in pairs(values) do list[#list + 1] = key end
  table.sort(list)
  print(name .. ": " .. table.concat(list, ","))
end

local function memoize(fn)
  local cache = {}
  return function(n)
    local cached = cache[n]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached, true end
    local value = fn(n)
    cache[n] = value
    return value, false
  end

  calls = calls + 1
  if n < 2 then return n end
  return slowFib(n - 1) + slowFib(n - 2)
end

  if n < 2 then return n end
  return fastFib(n - 1) + fastFib(n - 2)
end)

local function dump(source)
  local keys = {}
  for key in pairs(source) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
  table.sort(keys)

  local lines = {}
  for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
    local value = source[key]
    local shown
    if type(value) == "string" then
      shown = '"' .. value .. '"'
    elseif type(value) == "table" then
      shown = "<table>"
    else
      shown = tostring(value)
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s = %s", tostring(key), shown)
  end
  return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

  local cls = {}

  local meta = getmetatable(object)
  while meta do
    if meta == cls then return true end
    local parentMeta = getmetatable(meta)
    meta = parentMeta and parentMeta.__index

local function newCache(capacity)
  local order = {}
  local values = {}

  local function touch(key)
    for index, existing in ipairs(order) do
      if existing == key then
        table.remove(order, index)
        break
      end
    end
    order[#order + 1] = key
  end

  local cache = {}

  function cache.get(key)
    if values[key] == nil then return nil end
    touch(key)
    return values[key]
  end

  function cache.set(key, value)
    values[key] = value
    touch(key)
    while #order > capacity do
      local evicted = table.remove(order, 1)
      values[evicted] = nil
    end
  end

  function cache.keys()
    return table.concat(order, ",")
  end

local function newTodoList()
  local items = {}
  local nextId = 1

  local commands = {}

  function commands.add(title)
    items[nextId] = { id = nextId, title = title, done = false }
    nextId = nextId + 1
    return "已添加：" .. title
  end

  function commands.list()
    local lines = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
      local mark = item.done and "[x]" or "[ ]"
      lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s %d. %s", mark, item.id, item.title)
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
  end

    local item = items[tonumber(id)]
    if not item then return nil, "找不到 " .. tostring(id) end
    item.done = true
    return "已完成：" .. item.title
  end

  return function(name, ...)
    local handler = commands[name]
    if not handler then return nil, "未知命令：" .. tostring(name) end
    return handler(...)
  end
end

local function escape(value)
  return (tostring(value):gsub("[\\\n=]", function(ch)
    if ch == "\n" then return "\\n" end
    if ch == "\\" then return "\\\\" end
    return "\\="
  end))
end

local function unescape(text)
  return (text:gsub("\\(.)", function(ch)
    if ch == "n" then return "\n" end
    return ch
  end))
end

local function serialize(config, order)
  local lines = {}
  for _, key in ipairs(order) do
    lines[#lines + 1] = key .. "=" .. escape(config[key])
  end
  return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function deserialize(text)
  local result = {}
  for line in text:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
    local key, value = line:match("^([^=]+)=(.*)$")
    if key then result[key] = unescape(value) end
  end
  return result
end

local function newBus()
  local events = {}
  local bus = {}

  function bus.on(name, handler)
    events[name] = events[name] or {}
    local list = events[name]
    list[#list + 1] = handler
    return function()
      for index, existing in ipairs(list) do
        if existing == handler then
          table.remove(list, index)
          return
        end
      end
    end
  end

  function bus.emit(name, ...)
    local list = events[name]
    if not list then return 0 end
    local snapshot = {}
    for index, handler in ipairs(list) do snapshot[index] = handler end
    local calls = 0
    for _, handler in ipairs(snapshot) do
      handler(...)
      calls = calls + 1
    end
    return calls
  end

  return bus
end

local function serialize(value, indent, visited)
  indent = indent or 0
  visited = visited or {}
  local pad = string.rep("  ", indent)

  if type(value) == "string" then
    local escapes = { ['\\'] = '\\\\', ['"'] = '\\"',
      ['\n'] = '\\n', ['\r'] = '\\r', ['\t'] = '\\t' }
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[%z\1-\31\\"]', function(ch)
      return escapes[ch] or string.format("\\x%02X", string.byte(ch))
    end) .. '"'
  end
  if type(value) ~= "table" then
    return tostring(value)
  end
  if visited[value] then return "<cycle>" end
  visited[value] = true

  local length, count = #value, 0
  local isArray = length > 0
  for key in pairs(value) do
    count = count + 1
    if type(key) ~= "number" or key % 1 ~= 0 or key < 1 or key > length then
      isArray = false
    end
  end
  isArray = isArray and count == length
  local lines = {}
  if isArray then
    for index = 1, length do
      lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("  ", indent + 1)
        .. serialize(value[index], indent + 1, visited)
    end
  else
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do
      assert(type(key) == "string", "对象分支只支持字符串键")
      keys[#keys + 1] = key
    end
    table.sort(keys)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("  ", indent + 1)
        .. key .. " = " .. serialize(value[key], indent + 1, visited)
    end
  end
  visited[value] = nil

  if #lines == 0 then return "{}" end
  return "{\n" .. table.concat(lines, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad .. "}"
end
